[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/26 (Sun) 14:29  
[USER] User is excited to try propagating Dendrobium orchid cuttings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended best practices for caring for Dendrobium orchid cuttings during propagation:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Sterilize cutting tools with a mixture of one part bleach and nine parts water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Choose healthy stems with several nodes for cuttings; avoid old or thick stems.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Prepare the cutting by cutting just below a node and removing leaves from the bottom part.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use rooting hormone to help the cutting produce roots; dip the end and remove excess.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Place the cutting in a jar of water or a pot with well-draining orchid mix; change water regularly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Keep the cutting in a bright location away from direct sunlight; maintain temperature at 65-75°F.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Monitor the cutting regularly; rooting can take several weeks to months.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Start fertilizing with a balanced orchid fertilizer once roots develop.  
[USER] Asked for advice on how often to change the water for Dendrobium orchid cuttings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended changing the water every 2-3 days to prevent bacterial and fungal growth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised to replace water immediately if it looks cloudy or smells bad.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructed that the cutting should not be entirely submerged in water to avoid rot.  
[USER] Will keep an eye on the cutting every few days.  
[USER] Asked for tips on how to keep the cutting from falling over in the water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using a support system to keep the cutting upright.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended using a small container like a shot glass or test tube, filling it with water to submerge only the bottom of the cutting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised using pebbles or aquarium gravel to help hold the cutting upright.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using a small stick or wooden skewer for additional support.  
[USER] Decided to try the shot glass method to keep the cutting upright.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Encouraged the user to remember to change the water regularly and monitor the cutting for signs of stress or disease.
